claude-code:cc-holo-plan-001#1.user_text: Build the holodeck frontend and backend specs for a local dashboard.
claude-code:cc-holo-plan-001#1.response_text:
I mapped the dashboard around the repo surfaces Randy uses during AI-coding work: worktrees, branch state, app registry, OpenSpec changes, reusable skills, AI sessions, and deploy targets.

The implementation plan keeps the collector and static frontend separate. The backend owns snapshot assembly and source parsing. The frontend owns rendering, sample mode, drawers, filters, and local UI state.

Verification should include sample-mode rendering and live API smoke tests once the FastAPI service is running.
claude-code:cc-holo-plan-001#1.response_final_text: Holodeck is scoped as a local dashboard with backend collection and frontend rendering split cleanly.
claude-code:cc-holo-plan-001#1.response_recap: The turn established Holodeck as a local dashboard over repo surfaces and separated backend collector work from frontend rendering.

claude-code:cc-holo-plan-001#2.user_text: Delegate frontend and backend implementation to separate file-disjoint executors.
claude-code:cc-holo-plan-001#2.response_text:
I split the work into two file-disjoint tasks. The backend task owns the turns database, label derivation, ingestion, correlation, digest generation, API endpoints, tests, and README updates. The frontend task owns only apps/holodeck/web and should extend the current UI, especially the entrypoint display that already landed in commit 9ee24c8.

The frontend should read from the documented turns endpoints and use client-side session filtering if the backend does not add a session query parameter.
claude-code:cc-holo-plan-001#2.response_final_text: The handoff is ready with backend and frontend file ownership separated for concurrent executors.

codex:codex-holo-front-101#1.user_text: You are the implementation executor for Holodeck frontend. Implement the static frontend exactly against the snapshot API contract. Do not commit or push.
codex:codex-holo-front-101#1.response_text:
I built the static frontend as a vanilla JavaScript dashboard that consumes the snapshot API, renders sample data when requested, and keeps write controls disabled in sample mode.

The worktree cards show editable per-branch state, recent sessions, app chips, and branch metadata. The AI Sessions table opens a drawer with lazily loaded messages. The next frontend step is to layer turn digests above that raw message stream once the turns API contract exists.
codex:codex-holo-front-101#1.response_final_text: The static frontend now renders the snapshot-driven dashboard and is ready for the turns API layer.
